# Standard Support

> A ready-made design for support tickets from AI agents: four MCP tools (support_open_ticket, support_list_tickets,
> support_get_ticket, support_reply_to_ticket) and a watch URL per ticket, so a customer's agent can report a problem
> to a product's team, read the reply and answer it. A design to copy, not a protocol to conform to. Made by DocSpring.

- [The whole site as Markdown](https://standardsupport.dev/index.md): the example, why, the spec, questions and adopters
- [The spec](https://standardsupport.dev/spec.md): every tool, field, status and rule, with its reason
- [The agent skill](https://github.com/DocSpring/standardsupport/tree/main/skills/standard-support): builds it into an existing MCP server
- [The reference server](https://github.com/DocSpring/standardsupport/tree/main/examples/reference-server): a small working example in JavaScript
